**Reasoning:**
Yellow Leaf disease in sugarcane is characterized by progressive yellowing starting from the midrib on the underside of the leaf. Early stages show exactly this bicolor pattern — green adaxial surface with yellowed abaxial/midrib surface. The test image perfectly matches this early-stage presentation. The other candidates don't fit: Brown Spot shows discrete brown spots, Leaf Scald shows pale streak lesions with water-soaked margins, Streak Mosaic/Mosaic shows mosaic/streak patterns, and Pokkah Boeng affects young leaves with twisted/distorted growth.
